Set this claim to Waiting on Customer.

I can't set that status here. **Waiting on Customer** only applies to service requests. A claim like [00002216](/lightning/r/500aj00003jLAOcAAO/view) moves through New, Under Investigation, Appraisal, Approved, Payment Issued, then Closed or Denied. It's in **Under Investigation** now.

If you're waiting on the Okafors, I can add a follow-up task or a file note to track that instead. Or tell me which claim status you want and I'll get it ready for you to confirm.
